schedule.title: Open period
schedule.hint: Outside the period the form shows a closed notice and rejects submissions. A season whose end is before its start wraps over new year.

access.title: Who can use this form
access.availabilityWebHint: The public page and the API are both available.
access.availabilityApiHint: No public page: the form can only be read and submitted through the API.
access.authTokenHint: Token forms are API only: a token cannot be typed into a page.
access.saveHint: Availability and authentication are saved with the form. Tokens and the password take effect immediately.
access.tokensHint: Send a token as Authorization: Bearer TOKEN or in the x-form-token header. It is shown only once.
access.tokensInactive: Tokens are only checked when authentication is set to API token.
access.tokenCreated: Copy this token now. You will not see it again.
access.passwordMissing: No password is set, so nobody can open this form yet.
access.passwordInactive: It is only checked when authentication is set to Shared password.
access.apiHint: Submit with POST (JSON, or multipart with file:KEY parts). The definition is available with GET on /api/forms/{slug}.
access.passwordHint: This form is protected. Enter the password you were given.

delivery.title: Delivery & storage
delivery.storeHint: Keep submissions in the database so they can be reviewed under Submissions.
delivery.filesWarning: This form has file upload fields, which need stored submissions. Remove them or keep storing.
delivery.lostWarning: Submissions are neither stored nor emailed. Add recipients or keep storing, or answers are lost unless something handles forms:submitted.
delivery.recipientsHint: Press Enter after each address. Leave empty to turn email off.
delivery.subject: Subject
delivery.replyToHint: The answer of this email field becomes the Reply-To.
delivery.routingHint: Send to other recipients depending on the answer. Others get the default recipients.
delivery.subjectHint: Variables from the list below work here too.
delivery.bodyHint: Optional. Leave empty to email the list of all answers. Variables are replaced with the submitted values.
delivery.bodyVariables: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor. The full list of answers is
delivery.needRecipients: Add recipients first to set the subject, reply-to and routing.

captcha.missingKey: The {provider} captcha has no site key configured.
captcha.missingKeyHint: Set the site key below or the NUXT_PUBLIC_FORMS_CAPTCHA_PROVIDER_SITE_KEY environment variable. Submissions also need the matching secret key on the server.
captcha.loadFailed: The captcha could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
captcha.siteKeyHint: Public key of this site. Leave empty to use the one configured for the provider.
captcha.hint: Always required while visible. The token is checked on the server and never stored. Submissions with an API token skip it.
captcha.secretHint: Server-side key used to verify this form. Stored encrypted and never shown again. Without one, the environment variable is used.
captcha.secretUnreadable: The stored secrets of this form cannot be decrypted because the encryption key changed. Enter them again.
captcha.secretPlaceholderSet: Enter a new secret key to replace it
captcha.secretFailed: The secret key could not be saved.
captcha.secretImmediate: Saved immediately, independent of the form Save.
